Functions
Overview
Southeast Gas Branch (PV GAS SE) is a branch of PetroVietnam Gas Joint Stock Corporation (PV GAS), playing a key role in gathering, receiving, processing, transporting and distributing gas in the Southeast region of Vietnam.
06 core functions
Gas gathering & transport
Gathering, transport and storage of offshore wet gas.
01
Gas processing
Processing wet gas into LPG, condensate and sales dry gas.
02
Gas product distribution
Distributing sales dry gas, LPG and condensate products.

CO₂ Trial Coordination
01Operational coordinationGood point
Thien Ung CO₂ content increase trial

During the recent trial to increase the CO₂ content in Thien Ung gas, IGPV facilitated and supported PV GAS and VSP in monitoring, updating and exchanging daily operational information in compliance with the Coordination Procedure between PV GAS and IGPV.

Shared samples for quality assessment

IGPV supported PV GAS SE in sample collection and facilitated PV GAS SE's use of the shared Thien Ung gas and condensate samples collected at SV-CPP during the pre-trial and trial periods for analysis and quality assessment, supporting the evaluation of the trial results.

Barred Tee Sample
01Operational coordinationGood point

In September 2026, IGPV further supported PV GAS SE by providing a gas sample collected at the Barred Tee for PV GAS SE to conduct further analyses and studies.

Organic vs inorganic

Barred tee sample: high organic content (65%). TU SC vessel sample: 93.18% inorganic.

SARA analysis

Both samples are mainly saturated hydrocarbons + asphaltenes; minor aromatics and resins.

Corrosion products

Barred tee: relatively high Fe₂O₃ (lower than the previous IGPV sample). TU SC vessel: no Fe₂O₃, only trace Fe₃O₄.

Hydrocarbon nature

Unidentified hydrocarbons (complex / oxidized / biodegraded) reached 77 - 80%.
